title: Bacteriological Evaluation of Children With Otorrhea
official: Bacteriological Evaluation of Spontaneous Otorrhea in Children
summary: After pneumococcal conjugate vaccine implementation, the number of acute otitis media (AOM) episodes has decreased, but AOM still remains among the most common diagnoses in childhood. From 2% to 17% of cases of AOM feature spontaneous perforation of the tympanic membrane (SPTM). The aim of this study was to describe the bacteriological causes of SPTM several years after PCV13 implementation, in 2010.

interventions.name: middle ear fluid sample for bacterial analysis (conventional microbiology analysis)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* children from 3 months to 15 years old
* with otorrhea
* signed parents consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* children under 3 months
* children \> 15 years old
sponsor: Association Clinique Thérapeutique Infantile du val de Marne
